question.question: What is the 100K development-MAE spread across initializations of the retained BondLocal + pair-update-norm GPT-T recipe, and does it undercut the E1 3.7 meV screen?
question.deficiency: E1 gates on two pairs at -3.7 meV; the GPT-T 100K init noise is unmeasured (K1 100K spread was 1.63 meV), so the screen's power is unknown.
alternatives: GPT-T 100K init spread is small and E1 has adequate power
Spread is large and E1 cannot resolve a 3.7 meV effect
question.positive_decision: D = max - min of development MAE over ref_s43, ref_s44, ref_s45, ref_s46 <= 1.85 meV (3.7 = 2D): E1 screening power adequate; no change to the E1 gate.
question.negative_decision: D > 1.85 meV: add a power caveat to the E1 conclusion only; the E1 gate is unchanged. No retry, tuning or adoption.

profile.hardware: Tesla T4x2 FP32/noTF32, one arm per device
profile.cheapest_falsifier: Two reference-only 100K 60-pass arms (inits 45, 46) added to the E1 references (43, 44); D > 1.85 meV means two E1 pairs cannot resolve 3.7 meV.
